title: Onboard aurora-lite-3b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Priya Nair
description: Onboard aurora-lite-3b v1.0 into the model registry with full metadata, model versioning, curated performance profiles for common instance types, and automated changelog/release note generation. Motivation: aurora-lite-3b is a small, fast model aimed at latency-sensitive downstream features; adding it to the registry allows routing, profiling, and automated release notes so consumers can adopt consistently. Changes include model metadata (sha256, tokenizer, config), performance profiles for A100/T4/CPU modes, a validation script that exercises a small prompt set and checks latency/throughput, integration tests for registry ingestion and examples/quickstart, and an update to the changelog generator to include model onboarding entries when metadata/version fields change. Checklist: [x] metadata added and schema-validated [x] perf profiles added and sanity-tested on A100 and T4 [x] changelog automation updated to emit structured release notes [x] unit and integration tests added [x] docs quickstart updated. Rollout: staged merge to main, smoke tests on staging, follow-up monitoring for latency regressions under ENG-2145. See linked linear items for rollout tasks.

release_notes: Added aurora-lite-3b v1.0 to the model registry. Includes metadata, recommended perf profiles for A100 and T4, validation and integration tests, and automated changelog entries for model onboarding. Recommended migration: use profile 'aurora-lite-3b-a100' for high-throughput use cases and 'aurora-lite-3b-t4' for cost-sensitive deployments.
notes_for_release_engineers: After merge, trigger perf lab validation job and verify instance-specific metrics for a100 and t4 profiles. Announce in #model-registry channel and update the model catalog page. If any latency regressions are spotted, rollback the profile changes and open ENG-2145.
testing_summary: Unit and integration tests cover metadata schema validation, registry ingestion, and changelog generation. Perf smoke runs executed against a100 and t4 in perf-lab. All CI checks passed after one rerun of flaky integration test.
additional_context: This PR is part of a batch of onboarding tasks for smaller low-latency models tracked under ENG-2145. The changelog automation change will also pick up subsequent minor version bumps for models when metadata.version changes.
example_instructions: To try locally: python tools/registry_client.py register models/aurora-lite-3b/metadata.json && python scripts/validate_model.py --model aurora-lite-3b --profile a100
